method: Written by hand from one frame per second (frame round(s * fps) of clip.mp4), viewed with a pixel grid. Not from YOLO or any other detector.
camera: tripod: drift up to 27 px (the bath and the leaves sway; corners on the leaves move)
notes: A hanging bird bath; birds come and go all clip long, up to 3 at once. Identities across the bath are judged from position and plumage at 1 fps; a bird that leaves and comes back would be a new entry. The first 60 s of the source video.
